signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Brand blue — decorative color blocks, icon fills, secondary borders, and the blue-tinted shadow that gives elevation its on-brand cast

pulse-green.$description: Pulse Green — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

hot-pink.$description: Hot Pink — Vivid pink — decorative strokes, confetti blocks, and gradient underline washes

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Pink action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

solar-yellow.$description: Solar Yellow — Yellow accent — confetti blocks, gradient underlines, and warm decorative surfaces

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange accent — decorative fills, strokes, and secondary button surfaces

forest-moss.$description: Forest Moss — Deep green — heading text color, card backgrounds, and muted button surfaces that need an earthy chromatic weight

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Warm orange — button backgrounds and body accent fills, slightly softer than Ember Orange

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Purple accent — rare chromatic punctuation for buttons and decorative fills

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Dark blue border — used for emphasis borders that need more weight than Signal Blue

azure.$description: Azure — Lighter blue border — paired with Deep Iris in decorative border compositions

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

deep-moss.$description: Deep Moss — Dark text/footer — near-black with a green undertone, used for footer backgrounds and deep heading text

concrete.$description: Concrete — Hairline border — the dominant neutral border color, appearing on virtually every element

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text and filled CTA — all body and heading text, plus filled button backgrounds

paper.$description: Paper — Card and nav surface — opaque white for cards, navigation bar, and button text

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark surface — footer background and inverted dark blocks, near-black with a slight teal undertone

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle background — off-white fill for sections that need separation from Paper without a visible border

pebble.$description: Pebble — Secondary border — slightly darker than Concrete for borders that need more weight

ash.$description: Ash — Border and shadow base — mid-gray borders and shadow midtones

smoke.$description: Smoke — Background wash — light gray fill for inactive states and subtle surface differentiation

stone.$description: Stone — Icon border — medium gray for icon outlines that recede behind content

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark card surface and stroke — deep neutral for inverted cards and decorative strokes

iron.$description: Iron — Muted text and icon fill — secondary text color, icon fills, and decorative strokes

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary border and shadow — mid-gray for low-emphasis borders and shadow accents

neue-haas-grotesk-display.$description: Primary typeface — the editorial voice of the brand. Drives the 244px display headline that defines the hero, all headings down to 14px nav links. The extreme range from 244px to 14px in a single family creates visual cohesion: one geometric grotesque doing everything from poster-scale headlines to micro-labels.

inter.$description: Secondary typeface — handles compact UI chrome: fine-print body text, captions, tabular data, and icon-adjacent labels below 16px. Frees the primary face to own the editorial moments.
